object_description: angled, folded building volume around a central forecourt
design_condition: The building is oriented north toward the functional center, interlocks with several open spaces, and uses its placement to soften the relationship with the main road.

positive.statement: The contribution models a new central area in which uses interlock with various open spaces.

position.rationale: The folded perimeter visibly frames a central forecourt and interlocking open spaces.

positive.statement: The expressive appearance sought for the new building is successfully achieved.

position.rationale: The irregular folded mass and broad roof are clearly visible across all calibrated projections.

positive.statement: The social area and the outside part of the foyer are nicely grouped around the existing tree.

position.rationale: Interior social functions are approximated around the central forecourt-facing edge near the existing tree.

negative.statement: The diverse relationships from inside to outside lead to a multitude of individual solutions.

position.rationale: The folded perimeter exposes multiple façade orientations around the central open space.

negative.statement: The stage space harbors a variety of technical and acoustic risks requiring substantial technical resources.

position.rationale: The stage is not internally visible and is approximated within the larger western hall zone.

negative.statement: The hard surface around the project creates a separation of areas that is difficult to understand.

position.rationale: The surrounding ground plane is assigned to the outer eastern perimeter beyond the folded mass.

negative.statement: The western corner develops a kind of second rear side, counteracting the integrative efforts of the basic form.

position.rationale: The westernmost angled corner is clearly identifiable in plan and west-facing elevation.

negative.statement: The large spans and comparatively high proportion of glass are likely to have a negative impact on costs and overheating.

position.rationale: Glass and span concerns are assigned to the broad visible envelope of the main folded volume.
